metadata.title: Academic Trading Strategies Research
metadata.sources: Quantpedia, SSRN, ScienceDirect, NBER, Journal of Finance, PMC, AQR, arXiv
metadata.note: Only strategies with published rules, out-of-sample validation, and reproducible methodology

forex_strategies.name: FX Carry Trade (Interest Rate Differential)

paper.title: Carry Trades and Currency Crashes

trading_rules.entry: Go long the 3 currencies with highest central bank prime rates, short the 3 with lowest rates
trading_rules.exit: Monthly rebalancing based on updated interest rate rankings
trading_rules.universe: G10 currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CHF, AUD, NZD, CAD, NOK, SEK)

performance.out_of_sample: Alpha deteriorating post-2009, crash risk during risk-off periods

implementation.data_source: yfinance FX pairs, FRED for interest rates
implementation.additional_data: Central bank rates from FRED (DGS series, federal funds rate)

known_issues: Severe drawdowns during financial crises (2008: -30%+)
Carry trade crowding has reduced returns post-2010
Requires crash risk hedging (OTM puts on high-yield currencies)
Sharpe ratio is LOW at 0.29 - only viable combined with momentum/value
forex_strategies.enhancement: Combine with FX momentum and value (PPP) for Sharpe ~0.8-1.0 per AQR research

forex_strategies.name: Cross-Sectional FX Momentum

paper.title: Currency Momentum Strategies

trading_rules.entry: Rank 48 currencies by past 1-month or 3-month returns. Go long top quintile (past winners), short bottom quintile (past losers)

performance.out_of_sample: Persistent but weaker post-2010. Transaction costs reduce but do not eliminate returns

implementation.data_source: yfinance FX pairs
implementation.instruments: G10 FX pairs from yfinance; emerging FX harder to get
implementation.additional_data: None required beyond price data

known_issues: Returns partially explained by transaction costs in less liquid currencies
Momentum crashes possible (similar to equity momentum)
Post-publication decay observed but still positive
Shorter lookback (1mo) works better than longer (12mo) in FX
forex_strategies.enhancement: Use 1-month lookback, combine with carry for diversified FX strategy

forex_strategies.name: Currency Value Factor (PPP Strategy)

paper.title: Value and Momentum Everywhere

trading_rules.entry: Use OECD PPP data to calculate fair value vs USD. Adjust monthly using CPI. Go long 3 most undervalued currencies, short 3 most overvalued
trading_rules.exit: Quarterly or monthly rebalancing based on updated PPP valuations

performance.out_of_sample: Alpha deteriorating in OOS period. Slightly negative post-2009

implementation.data_source: OECD PPP data (free), FRED CPI data, yfinance FX
implementation.additional_data: OECD PPP figures (stats.oecd.org), monthly CPI from FRED

known_issues: Very slow mean reversion (5-10 year horizons)
OOS performance negative - standalone NOT recommended
Only works well combined with carry and momentum
PPP data updates are slow (monthly at best)
forex_strategies.enhancement: Only use as part of combined carry+momentum+value FX portfolio

forex_strategies.name: FX Volatility Risk Premium (Straddle Selling)

paper.title: Trading the FX Volatility Risk Premium with Machine Learning

trading_rules.entry: Sell 1-week ATM straddles on EUR/USD every weekday. ML model times entries to avoid unfavorable conditions (high VIX regime, NFP days)
trading_rules.exit: Expiration (1 week). Stop-loss at 2x premium collected
trading_rules.universe: EUR/USD primarily; can extend to major pairs

performance.out_of_sample: ML-timed version significantly outperforms naive selling

implementation.data_source: Options data NOT available on yfinance. Need broker API (IBKR, Deribit)
implementation.additional_data: Implied volatility surfaces, realized volatility

known_issues: Tail risk: losses up to 800% of premium in crashes
Requires options data and trading capability
NOT implementable with yfinance alone
High margin requirements
ML model adds complexity but is critical for risk management
forex_strategies.enhancement: Buy OTM puts as crash protection. Use IV-RV spread as entry filter

forex_strategies.name: Combined FX Carry + Momentum + Value

paper.title: FX Carry + Value + Momentum Strategies over Their 200+ Year History
paper.journal: Journal of Derivatives & Hedge Funds / Quantpedia

trading_rules.entry: Equal-weight combination: 1/3 carry (rate differential), 1/3 momentum (1-3mo returns), 1/3 value (PPP deviation). Each factor ranks G10 currencies, long top 3, short bottom 3

performance.out_of_sample: Robust across multiple centuries. Negative correlation between factors provides natural hedge

implementation.data_source: yfinance FX pairs, FRED interest rates, OECD PPP data
implementation.additional_data: FRED rates, OECD PPP

known_issues: Individual factor returns are modest - combination is key
Still vulnerable to extreme risk-off events but much less than pure carry
Requires three data sources to maintain
forex_strategies.enhancement: THIS IS THE RECOMMENDED FX STRATEGY. Best risk-adjusted returns come from combining all three factors. AQR data freely available for validation.

commodity_strategies.name: Commodity Momentum (12-Month Lookback)

paper.title: Momentum Strategies in Commodity Markets

trading_rules.entry: Rank 31 commodity futures by past 12-month return. Go long top quintile, short bottom quintile

performance.out_of_sample: Post-2004 returns lower but still positive

implementation.data_source: yfinance commodity futures (limited), Quandl/Nasdaq for full coverage
implementation.yfinance_implementable: partial - yfinance has some commodity futures but not all 31
implementation.additional_data: Full commodity futures data from Quandl or broker API

known_issues: Extreme max drawdown (-79.75%) makes pure momentum risky
Limited commodity futures on yfinance
Combine with term structure for better risk-adjusted returns
Momentum crashes in commodities are less frequent than stocks
commodity_strategies.enhancement: Double-sort with term structure signal increases Sharpe from 0.57 to 0.96

commodity_strategies.name: Commodity Term Structure (Backwardation/Contango)

paper.title: The Fundamentals of Commodity Futures Returns

trading_rules.entry: Compute roll yield (front-month minus second-month price, annualized). Long top 20% highest roll-yield (backwardation), short bottom 20% (contango)

performance.out_of_sample: Chinese commodity markets 2020-2023: Sharpe improved to 0.75-1.08

implementation.data_source: Requires multi-contract futures data (front + deferred months)
implementation.yfinance_implementable: partial - yfinance only provides front-month; need Quandl for deferred
implementation.instruments: Commodity futures with multiple contract months
implementation.additional_data: Quandl continuous futures for roll yield calculation

known_issues: Requires multi-contract data (harder to source for free)
High max drawdown in standalone mode
Term structure can flip rapidly during supply shocks
commodity_strategies.enhancement: Combined momentum + term structure strategy achieves 21% annual return with Sharpe ~0.96

commodity_strategies.name: Commodity Seasonal Patterns

paper.title: Return Seasonality in Commodity Futures

trading_rules.entry: Trade seasonal patterns that recur >70% of years historically. Key patterns: Corn bottoms Sep-Oct (long Oct, exit Feb). Natural gas rallies Apr-May (long Mar, exit May). Wheat bottoms Jul (long Jul, exit Nov). Soybeans bottom Oct (long Oct, exit May)
trading_rules.exit: Calendar-based exits aligned with seasonal windows
trading_rules.universe: Agricultural commodities, natural gas, heating oil
trading_rules.rebalancing: Seasonal (2-4 trades per commodity per year)

performance.out_of_sample: Patterns persist but U.S. shale has reduced natural gas seasonality by ~40% since 2010

implementation.data_source: yfinance for main commodities
implementation.additional_data: USDA crop reports for confirmation

known_issues: Climate change disrupting traditional agricultural patterns
Shale revolution reduced natural gas seasonality
Overcrowding as patterns are well-known
Individual seasonal trades have high variance
commodity_strategies.enhancement: Use as overlay on momentum/term structure, not standalone. Front-run seasonal pattern by 2-4 weeks (Quantpedia research)

commodity_strategies.name: Commodity Carry (Convenience Yield Risk)

paper.title: Convenience Yield Risk

trading_rules.entry: Compute convenience yield volatility (CYR) for each commodity from nearby futures contracts. Long commodities with highest CYR, short lowest CYR

performance.out_of_sample: Persistent premium identified across multiple sub-periods

implementation.data_source: Multi-contract futures data required
implementation.instruments: Multiple futures contract months per commodity
implementation.additional_data: Quandl/Nasdaq continuous futures, storage cost estimates

known_issues: Requires sophisticated multi-contract data
Convenience yield estimation is noisy
Storage cost assumptions affect results
commodity_strategies.enhancement: Better suited as research signal than standalone strategy

commodity_strategies.name: Gold Safe-Haven Timing Strategy

paper.title: Revisiting the Safe Haven Role of Gold
paper.journal: North American Journal of Economics and Finance (PMC)

trading_rules.entry: Go long gold when: (1) VIX > 25 AND rising, (2) 10Y-2Y yield spread inverts, (3) Credit spreads (BAA-AAA) > 2.5%. Use DCC-GARCH correlation regime to confirm negative stock-gold correlation
trading_rules.exit: Exit when VIX drops below 20 AND yield curve normalizes. Trailing stop at 8%

performance.out_of_sample: Gold lost safe-haven property briefly in 2020 (liquidity crisis) then regained it

implementation.data_source: yfinance for gold (GC=F, GLD), FRED for VIX, yield curve, credit spreads
implementation.additional_data: FRED: T10Y2Y (yield curve), BAMLC0A0CM (credit spread), DGS10

known_issues: Gold can fail as safe haven during liquidity crises (March 2020)
Rising real rates historically negative for gold (2022)
Timing signals are lagging indicators
Recent gold surge (2024-2025) driven by central bank buying, not traditional safe-haven
commodity_strategies.enhancement: Better as portfolio hedge allocation (5-15%) than timing strategy

futures_strategies.name: Time-Series Momentum (Trend Following)

paper.title: Time Series Momentum

trading_rules.entry: For each of 58 instruments: if 12-month excess return > 0, go long; if < 0, go short
trading_rules.exit: Monthly rebalancing. Position reversed when 12-month signal flips
trading_rules.universe: 58 liquid futures: 24 commodities, 12 FX, 9 equity indices, 13 gov bonds
trading_rules.position_sizing: Inversely proportional to instrument volatility (vol-targeting). Target 40% annual vol for full portfolio

performance.out_of_sample: Robust. AQR has run live TSMOM strategies since 2009. Recent research shows optimal lookback 5-7 months for European equities (Sharpe ~1.0)

implementation.data_source: yfinance for equity index futures, FX, some commodities. Full replication needs Quandl
implementation.yfinance_implementable: partial - can implement for ~25-30 instruments on yfinance
implementation.additional_data: Risk-free rate from FRED for excess return calculation

known_issues: 12-month lookback is slow to reverse in whipsaw markets
Multi-horizon approach (combining 1/3/6/12 month signals) outperforms single lookback
TSMOM struggles in range-bound, choppy markets
Performance attribution: commodities contribute >50% of Sharpe
futures_strategies.enhancement: THIS IS A TOP-TIER STRATEGY. Use EWMA vol-targeting, multi-horizon signals (1+3+6+12 month average). Combine with cross-sectional momentum

futures_strategies.name: VIX Futures Term Structure Trading

paper.title: A Note on Trading the Term Structure of VIX Futures

trading_rules.entry: Short nearest VIX future (>=10 days to expiry) when contango daily roll > 0.10 pts. Long when backwardation daily roll < -0.10 pts. Daily roll = (VIX future - VIX spot) / days to settlement
trading_rules.exit: Hold for 5 trading days. Hedge with E-mini S&P 500 futures (regression-based hedge ratio)

performance.out_of_sample: Slightly negative OOS. VIX constant maturity ML approach (2024) achieves IR 0.623

implementation.data_source: CBOE VIX futures data (not on yfinance). Need broker or CBOE data
implementation.additional_data: VIX spot, VIX futures term structure from CBOE

known_issues: OOS performance degraded significantly
VIX spikes can cause catastrophic losses on short positions
Requires futures trading capability
High margin requirements
Volmageddon (Feb 2018) wiped out several VIX short strategies
futures_strategies.enhancement: ML-enhanced timing (2024 paper) significantly improves risk-adjusted returns. Use strict position limits

futures_strategies.name: Cross-Asset Time-Series Momentum

paper.title: Cross-Asset Signals and Time Series Momentum

trading_rules.entry: Standard TSMOM (12-month return signal) PLUS cross-asset signals: past bond returns positively predict equity returns; past equity returns negatively predict bond returns. Combine own-asset and cross-asset signals equally
trading_rules.universe: Equity indices, government bonds, commodities, currencies (same as TSMOM)
trading_rules.lookback_period: 12 months for own-asset, various for cross-asset

performance.out_of_sample: 2025 paper (Xu) confirms I-XTSM strategy shows higher Sharpe, lower drawdown than single-asset TSMOM

implementation.data_source: yfinance for equities, bonds, commodities, FX
implementation.additional_data: Bond futures or TLT ETF as proxy

known_issues: Cross-asset correlations can break during regime changes
Requires careful bond-equity correlation monitoring
More complex signal generation than pure TSMOM
futures_strategies.enhancement: THIS IS THE HIGHEST SHARPE STRATEGY FOUND (1.84). Cross-asset signals add ~40% to Sharpe over standard TSMOM

futures_strategies.name: CTA/Managed Futures Trend Replication

paper.title: Demystifying Managed Futures
paper.updated_by: Kaminski and Zhao 2025, Re-evaluating Short/Long-Term Trend Factors 2025

trading_rules.entry: Multi-timeframe lookback-straddle approach. For each instrument, compute EWMA trend signals at 20-day, 60-day, 125-day, 250-day, 500-day windows. Weight signals: emphasize 20d (short-term) and 500d (long-term), as these dominate 2020-2025 returns. Go long/short based on weighted signal direction
trading_rules.exit: Signal reversal at any dominant timeframe
trading_rules.universe: 60+ futures across equities, bonds, commodities, FX
trading_rules.rebalancing: Daily signal assessment, position changes monthly
trading_rules.position_sizing: Vol-targeted at 10-15% portfolio vol. Average gross leverage 4x AUM

performance.out_of_sample: 20d and 500d timeframes dominate 2020-2025. 60d/125d underperform. 20-35 round-turns per year

implementation.data_source: yfinance for major futures, needs Quandl for full 60+ instrument coverage
implementation.additional_data: EWMA half-life calibration data

known_issues: Requires high leverage (4x) to generate meaningful returns
Middle timeframes (60d, 125d) have been drag on performance recently
Index replication typically captures 60-80% of CTA index returns
Requires daily monitoring and sophisticated position management
futures_strategies.enhancement: Focus on 20d and 500d timeframes (dominant 2020-2025). Skip 60d/125d to improve Sharpe

futures_strategies.name: Overnight-Intraday Return Reversal

paper.title: Overnight-Intraday Reversal Everywhere

trading_rules.entry: If overnight return (close-to-open) is positive, go short at open for the day (and vice versa). Applies to equity index futures
trading_rules.exit: Close at end of trading day

performance.out_of_sample: Pattern persists but extreme turnover makes it impractical for most traders

implementation.data_source: yfinance for daily OHLC data sufficient for basic implementation
implementation.additional_data: None - just need reliable open/close prices

known_issues: EXTREME turnover (daily trading) makes this largely unviable after costs
Retail sentiment drives the anomaly - may diminish as markets evolve
Slippage at open is significant
Sharpe varies wildly between sub-periods
Academic consensus: not viable as trading strategy due to costs
futures_strategies.enhancement: Use as a FILTER (not standalone): avoid buying at open when overnight return was extremely positive

futures_strategies.name: Treasury Yield Curve Butterfly Strategy

paper.title: Trading the Treasury Yield Curve

trading_rules.entry: 2s10s30s butterfly: Buy 2x 2Y T-Note futures + Buy 1x 30Y Bond futures, Sell 3x 10Y T-Note futures (DV01-weighted). Enter when 10Y yield is >20bps above interpolated 2Y/30Y midpoint
trading_rules.exit: When butterfly spread normalizes (10Y moves back in line). Stop at 2x initial spread widening

performance.out_of_sample: 2s10s30s butterfly improves Sharpe vs 2s10s flattener alone due to volatility reduction

implementation.data_source: FRED for yields, yfinance for Treasury ETFs (SHY, IEF, TLT)
implementation.additional_data: FRED: DGS2, DGS10, DGS30 for yield curve

known_issues: Low absolute returns (5% annual)
Requires DV01-weighting knowledge
Curve can move in unexpected ways during Fed interventions
Bond ETFs are imperfect proxies for futures
futures_strategies.enhancement: Combine with yield curve regime indicators (steepening/flattening regime from slope change)

stock_strategies.name: Stock Momentum (12-1 Month)

paper.title: Returns to Buying Winners and Selling Losers
paper.updated_by: Factor Momentum and the Momentum Factor (Ehsani, Linnainmaa 2020)

trading_rules.entry: Rank NYSE/AMEX/NASDAQ stocks by past 12-month return (skip most recent month). Go long top decile, short bottom decile

performance.out_of_sample: U.S. momentum returns 50% LOWER 1996-2016 vs prior 20 years. Long-only version outperforms long-short

implementation.data_source: yfinance for individual stocks
implementation.additional_data: Need universe list (S&P 500 constituents from Wikipedia/FRED)

known_issues: CATASTROPHIC drawdown risk (-87% in 2009 crash rebound)
Momentum crashes during market reversals
Post-publication decay: 50% lower returns since mid-1990s
Short leg is extremely risky and drives most of the drawdowns
LONG-ONLY momentum recommended for implementation
stock_strategies.enhancement: Use LONG-ONLY momentum on S&P 500. Skip the short leg entirely. Combine with quality factor for 'quality momentum'

stock_strategies.name: Short Interest Signal Strategy

paper.title: In Short Supply: Short-Sellers and Stock Returns
paper.updated_by: Anomalies and Their Short-Sale Costs (Muravyev, 2025 JoF)

trading_rules.entry: Sort all stocks monthly by short interest ratio (short interest / shares outstanding). Long lowest decile (least shorted). Short highest decile (most shorted). Equal weight

performance.out_of_sample: Alpha deteriorating in OOS. Short-sale costs eliminate most long-short abnormal returns (Muravyev 2022). Loan fee anomaly persists (4.01%/month L-S return)

implementation.data_source: Short interest data NOT on yfinance. Need FINRA, Ortex, or S3 Partners
implementation.additional_data: FINRA short interest reports (free, bi-monthly), stock lending fee data (paid)

known_issues: Short-sale costs ELIMINATE abnormal returns in long-short version (Muravyev 2022)
Short interest data is delayed (bi-monthly reporting)
Meme stock squeezes can destroy short leg (GME 2021)
LONG-ONLY version (avoiding highly shorted stocks) still works
Stock lending fee is better signal than short interest ratio
stock_strategies.enhancement: Use LONG-ONLY version: exclude stocks with high short interest from any long portfolio. Do NOT short highly shorted stocks (costs kill alpha)

stock_strategies.name: Post-Earnings Announcement Drift (PEAD)

paper.title: Post-Earnings Announcement Drift: Earnings Surprise and Investing Strategy

trading_rules.entry: After earnings announcement, buy stocks with positive earnings surprise (SUE > 0, standardized unexpected earnings). Use ORJ measure (order of rank in J quarters). Long top quintile SUE, short bottom quintile
trading_rules.exit: Hold for 60-90 trading days (one quarter). Alternatively, exit before next earnings

performance.out_of_sample: PEAD has been declining: from 18% (1989) toward insignificance in some studies. Enhanced version with multi-quarter SUE patterns nearly doubles Sharpe

implementation.data_source: yfinance for earnings dates. Need analyst estimates from separate source
implementation.yfinance_implementable: partial - yfinance has earnings dates but NOT analyst estimates/SUE
implementation.additional_data: Analyst estimates from Zacks, IBES, or free alternatives (FinViz, Yahoo Finance scraping)

known_issues: PEAD magnitude declining over time as markets become more efficient
Requires timely earnings data and analyst estimates
Enhanced multi-quarter approach revives the anomaly but adds complexity
Most returns accrue in first 1-5 days post-announcement
Long-only version (buying positive surprises) is more practical
stock_strategies.enhancement: Use elastic net model incorporating multiple quarters of SUE history to capture earnings autocorrelation. Focus on large-caps where enhanced PEAD is strongest

stock_strategies.name: Low Volatility Anomaly

paper.title: What We Know About the Low-Risk Anomaly: A Literature Review

trading_rules.entry: Rank all stocks by trailing 12-month return volatility (standard deviation of daily returns). Long bottom quintile (lowest vol), short top quintile (highest vol). Or: construct minimum variance portfolio using covariance matrix optimization

performance.out_of_sample: Low vol outperformed broad market by 10%+ YTD in 2025. Anomaly persists internationally

implementation.data_source: yfinance for all stock prices
implementation.additional_data: None beyond price data

known_issues: May be explained by exposure to other factors (quality, value)
Low vol stocks tend to be rate-sensitive (utilities, staples)
Underperforms in strong bull markets (2020-2021)
Sector concentration risk
Betting against beta (BAB) is the academic formulation
stock_strategies.enhancement: Combine with quality factor to get low-vol-quality portfolio. Use sector-neutral construction to avoid concentration

stock_strategies.name: Options Implied Volatility Spread Signal

paper.title: Why Does Options Market Information Predict Stock Returns?

trading_rules.entry: Compute IV spread = IV(ATM call) - IV(ATM put) for each stock. Sort stocks by IV spread. Go long stocks with highest IV spread (calls more expensive = informed bullish buying), short stocks with lowest IV spread

performance.out_of_sample: Predictive power decreases by 2/3 when excluding high-borrow-fee stocks. Strongest in medium/long-term horizons

implementation.data_source: Options data NOT on yfinance (implied vol). Need CBOE, OptionMetrics, or broker API
implementation.instruments: Options chain data for US stocks
implementation.additional_data: Options implied volatility data (paid service typically)

known_issues: IV spread largely proxies for short-sale costs (borrow fees)
Returns drop 66% when excluding hard-to-borrow stocks
Requires expensive options data
May be capturing same information as short interest signal
Complex to implement correctly (need clean IV surface data)
stock_strategies.enhancement: If you have options data, this is a strong signal. Otherwise, use short interest as cheaper proxy

stock_strategies.name: SEC Form 4 Insider Purchase Signal

paper.title: Insider Purchase Signals in Microcap Equities: Gradient Boosting Detection

trading_rules.entry: Monitor SEC Form 4 filings. Buy stocks where insiders purchase after 10%+ prior price appreciation (momentum + insider confirmation). Focus on microcaps. Use gradient boosting model to filter: transaction size, insider role, prior price momentum

performance.out_of_sample: Mean CAR of 6.3% for best signal cluster. But: 70-80% of alpha dissipates before public disclosure (Ozlen 2025)

implementation.data_source: SEC EDGAR for Form 4 filings (free), yfinance for prices
implementation.yfinance_implementable: partial - prices yes, Form 4 filings need SEC EDGAR API
implementation.additional_data: SEC EDGAR XBRL Form 4 filings, insider transaction codes

known_issues: 70-80% of alpha occurs BEFORE public filing (Ozlen 2025 - alpha death)
Microcap liquidity makes execution difficult
Filing delays mean information is already priced in
Returns negatively correlated with stock liquidity
Cluster buying (multiple insiders) is a stronger signal
stock_strategies.enhancement: Focus on cluster buys (3+ insiders buying within 2 weeks) in microcaps. Speed of execution is critical

stock_strategies.name: Congressional Trading Signal

paper.title: Inside the Beltway: Senator Trading and Legislative Gains

trading_rules.entry: Monitor congressional stock disclosure filings (STOCK Act). Buy stocks purchased by senators/house members, especially: (1) purchases before critical legislative events, (2) purchases during high economic policy uncertainty, (3) cluster buys by committee members
trading_rules.exit: Hold 3-6 months. Exit at 15% gain or after legislation passes
trading_rules.universe: US stocks traded by Congress members

performance.out_of_sample: Mixed evidence: some studies find 4.9% 3-month abnormal return, others find NO evidence of stock picking prowess (Belmont 2022)

implementation.data_source: Congressional trading data from Capitol Trades, Quiver Quantitative (free), or STOCK Act filings
implementation.yfinance_implementable: partial - prices yes, filing data from external APIs
implementation.instruments: US stocks disclosed in congressional filings
implementation.additional_data: Capitol Trades API, Quiver Quantitative API (free tier available)

known_issues: 45-day filing delay means information is stale
Conflicting academic evidence (some find alpha, some don't)
STOCK Act increased transparency but filing delays remain
Political risk: strategy relies on continued insider information asymmetry
Data quality issues with disclosure filings
stock_strategies.enhancement: Focus on senators on key committees (Finance, Armed Services). Use NLP to cross-reference with pending legislation

stock_strategies.name: ESG Factor Momentum

paper.title: ESG Momentum in International Equity Returns

trading_rules.entry: Rank MSCI World stocks by 12-month change in ESG rating. Overweight stocks with largest ESG upgrades, underweight stocks with largest ESG downgrades

performance.out_of_sample: OOS slightly negative. Mixed evidence: European short-term ESG momentum works, but loses significance with GMM. Annualized Sharpe 0.7 in 2002-2023 for out-of-sample mimicking portfolio

implementation.data_source: ESG ratings NOT on yfinance. Need MSCI ESG, Sustainalytics, or Refinitiv
implementation.additional_data: MSCI ESG ratings (paid), Sustainalytics (paid)

known_issues: ESG rating data is expensive and proprietary
Different rating providers give conflicting ESG scores
OOS alpha is deteriorating
Very low absolute returns (2.23% annual)
ESG backlash since 2022 may have changed the factor dynamics
stock_strategies.enhancement: NOT recommended as standalone. If ESG data available, use as supplementary signal with quality factor

stock_strategies.name: Intangible-Adjusted Value Strategy

paper.title: Best Performing Value Strategies (Quantpedia Analysis)

trading_rules.entry: Compute intangible-adjusted book-to-market ratio by capitalizing R&D and SGA expenses. Sort stocks into quintiles. Long highest adjusted-BM quintile, short lowest

performance.out_of_sample: Value strategies had strong comeback post-2020 after decade of underperformance. 5-year Sharpe 0.86

implementation.data_source: Financial statement data needed. Free from SEC EDGAR or SimFin
implementation.yfinance_implementable: partial - yfinance has some fundamentals but not R&D/SGA history
implementation.additional_data: SEC EDGAR XBRL financials, SimFin (free API), or Compustat (paid)

known_issues: Traditional book-to-market (Fama-French HML) has been dead since 2007
Intangible adjustment revives value factor significantly
Requires balance sheet data and accounting adjustments
Value timing is impossible - must hold through drawdowns
Strong recovery 2020-2025 may not persist
stock_strategies.enhancement: THIS is the modern value factor. Traditional book value is obsolete. Must adjust for intangibles (R&D, SGA capitalization)

cross_asset_strategies.name: Value and Momentum Everywhere (AQR)

paper.title: Value and Momentum Everywhere

trading_rules.entry: In each of 8 asset classes (US stocks, UK stocks, Europe stocks, Japan stocks, equity index futures, gov bonds, currencies, commodities): compute value and momentum signals. Long assets with high value + high momentum, short assets with low value + low momentum. Equal weight value and momentum signals. Negative correlation between them provides natural diversification
trading_rules.universe: 8 asset classes spanning 4 countries + 4 asset types

performance.out_of_sample: AQR provides updated monthly data. Strong common factor structure persists. Value/momentum negative correlation is the key diversification benefit

implementation.data_source: AQR publicly provides the factor data (free download from AQR website)
implementation.complexity: easy (using AQR data) / hard (replicating from scratch)
implementation.yfinance_implementable: partial - AQR data is best source. yfinance for replication
implementation.instruments: Stocks, bonds, currencies, commodities across 4+ countries
implementation.additional_data: AQR VME dataset (free): https://www.aqr.com/Insights/Datasets/Value-and-Momentum-Everywhere-Factors-Monthly

known_issues: Requires multi-asset implementation which adds complexity
Value factor was weak 2010-2020 but momentum offset losses
AQR data makes this easy to study but hard to trade at small scale
Currency hedging adds complexity for international stocks
cross_asset_strategies.enhancement: THIS IS THE GOLD STANDARD multi-factor strategy. AQR data is FREE. Start by replicating their published factors, then build your own signals

cross_asset_strategies.name: Equity Volatility Risk Premium

paper.title: Volatility Risk Premium Effect

trading_rules.entry: Each month, sell ATM straddle (1-month expiry) on S&P 500 at bid price (5% premium). Simultaneously buy 15% OTM puts for crash protection. Invest remaining cash in the index
trading_rules.exit: Hold to expiration (1 month). Roll into new straddle

performance.out_of_sample: Premium persists but tail risk is extreme. OTM put protection is essential

implementation.data_source: Options data required. NOT on yfinance. Need broker API
implementation.additional_data: VIX for regime filter, options chain data

known_issues: EXTREME TAIL RISK: losses up to 800% of premium in crashes
OTM put protection essential but reduces returns
Margin requirements are very high
Not implementable without options trading capability
Feb 2018 Volmageddon, March 2020 COVID destroyed many VRP strategies

key_findings_summary: Cross-asset time-series momentum (Sharpe 1.84) is the strongest published strategy with reproducible rules
Combining carry + momentum + value in FX produces robust 200+ year track record (Sharpe ~0.95)
AQR provides FREE monthly data for Value and Momentum Everywhere (Sharpe 1.10)
Traditional stock momentum has decayed 50% post-publication; LONG-ONLY version recommended
Intangible-adjusted value (Sharpe 0.86) replaces dead traditional book-to-market value factor
Short interest alpha is ELIMINATED by short-sale costs in long-short (Muravyev 2022, JoF)
Insider trading alpha: 70-80% occurs BEFORE public filing (essentially untradeable)
PEAD declining but enhanced multi-quarter approach revives it (elastic net on SUE history)
VIX term structure and volatility risk premium strategies carry catastrophic tail risk
Overnight-intraday reversal has high Sharpe in-sample but is unviable after transaction costs
CTA trend replication: focus on 20-day and 500-day timeframes (middle timeframes underperform 2020-2025)
Low volatility anomaly outperforming by 10%+ in 2025; combines well with quality factor
Commodity momentum + term structure double-sort achieves Sharpe 0.96 vs 0.57 standalone
ESG momentum: mixed evidence, expensive data, declining alpha - NOT recommended standalone
Congressional trading: conflicting evidence, 45-day filing delay limits practical alpha
